english.note: Use 嘻哈 as the all-purpose everyday noun for hip-hop when the context already makes clear whether you mean the culture or the music.

examples.english: I started listening to hip-hop when I was young, and I still love it.
examples.traditional: 我細個就開始聽嘻哈，依家仲係好鍾意。
